claim_scope: A model-held-constant comparison against frozen Mike and prior Luna one-shot arms. Sol criterion labels are provisional and derivative, not human gold.

landed_basis.best_simple_arms: Fresh Mike/high scored 172/225 at 590,911 logical tokens; native one-shot/xhigh scored 177/225 at 597,341; conflict-first scored 178/225 at 628,072.
landed_basis.failed_post_draft_review: A full append-only review scored 168/225 at 1,216,361 tokens. Context-size routing improved cost but scored only 175/225 at 688,751 tokens; its sole eligible review appended zero characters.
landed_basis.stable_long_context_omissions: All Tax arms exposed all 25 documents, yet 22 rubric criteria failed across fresh Mike, native one-shot, conflict-first, adaptive review, and monotonic review. The stable misses disproportionately concern exact exposure amounts, deadlines, jurisdictional requirements, contradictory terms, conditions, and complete action-matrix fields.
landed_basis.complementary_coverage: The fresh Mike/high and native one-shot criterion union is 189/225 despite individual scores of 172 and 177. The system has enough evidence and capacity for materially better coverage; initial attention allocation is the unresolved failure mode.
landed_basis.supported_invariant: Review after prose allocation is too late, while a second full-context provider round is costly. An autoregressive plan emitted immediately before authoring in the same response can allocate coverage before prose without replaying source input. Determinism can enforce evidence-before-plan order, source-size routing, the plan bound, exact persistence, and plan-before-draft order; it does not select legal content.

hypothesis: Preserve the native whole-source trajectory for small contexts. Above 400,000 exact normalized source characters, require one private plan tool call of at most 12,000 characters immediately before all generate_docx calls in the same assistant response. The plan prioritizes material findings, source locators, exact numbers/dates, contradictions, exceptions, uncertainty, priority, and intended placement. This is one continuous plan-then-act trajectory: no extra provider round, checkpoint handoff, evidence union, quote ledger, fact packet, legal scope, linter, or content-scoring compiler.

performer.system_mechanism: The host rejects planning until the fetch result has entered conversation history, rejects authoring when a required plan is absent, accepts plan then author calls in one ordered tool batch, and persists the exact private plan text, byte count, and SHA-256 in metrics.

tax/draft-transfer-pricing-documentation.expected_route: private plan then terminal authoring in one batch

capital-markets/draft-indenture-for-seni.expected_route: private plan then all terminal authoring calls in one batch

trace_gate: Require one complete exact-source fetch before authoring; the recorded task-agnostic source-size route; no plan on Banking; one bounded persisted plan before generate_docx on Tax and Indenture; plan and all author calls in the same second assistant batch; valid requested DOCX files; exact default tier and fingerprints; and zero tool, schema, or path errors. Inspect plan substance, ordering, cache, retries, tokens, reasoning, output size, and latency before judging.
decision_rule: Advance only at 182/225 or better, with no task below 58 Banking, 42 Tax, and 72 Indenture; no more than 1.25x the fresh Mike/high logical-token total of 590,911; and a structurally valid trace. Replicate only if the first pass clears this rule or is within observed score noise while the plans contain concrete source-grounded coverage that the drafts actually use.
